subject: Re: [AMBER] How to get code modifications into AmberTools

messages.author: Tharrington, Arnold
messages.body:
Hi Amber Developers,
I'm part of group at ORNL that is using Amber for docking studies. We have modified MDGX to allow for spatially fixed atoms. The modifications are minor. How does one get these changes pushed upstream to Amber? In particular, we could not find a repository to which to clone, branch, and push upstream for a merge-review. Any help in this matter would be greatly appreciated.
Arnold Tharrington
One Bethel Valley Road
P.O. BOX 2008, MS-6008
Oak Ridge, TN 37831-6008
Email: arnoldt.ornl.gov
Phone: 865-241-9393

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Aug 30, 2021, Tharrington, Arnold wrote:
>
>I'm part of group at ORNL that is using Amber for docking studies. We
>have modified MDGX to allow for spatially fixed atoms. The modifications
>are minor. How does one get these changes pushed upstream to Amber? In
>particular, we could not find a repository to which to clone, branch, and
>push upstream for a merge-review. Any help in this matter would be greatly
>appreciated.
You could email patch files to the mailing list (or to me).  If you think
you are likely to make more changes, we could get you access to
gitlab.ambermd.org, which is where our repository resides.  Send me email if
you are interested in this latter path.
....regards...dac
